description: Returns the current commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks: the prices in GEL at which a bank buys and sells one unit of a currency. Use it for the price of a currency at a bank today, or to compare banks. Ask for 1 to 10 currencies. buy: the price in GEL that the bank pays when you sell it one unit. sell: the price in GEL that the bank asks when you buy one unit from it. The banks of this server: basisbank (Basisbank), bog (Bank of Georgia), credo (Credo Bank), crystal (Crystal, a microfinance organization), halyk (Halyk Bank), inteli (Inteli Express, a microfinance organization), kursi (Kursi.ge, an online exchange bureau), liberty (Liberty Bank), mbc (MBC, a microfinance organization), mjc (MJC, a microfinance organization), rico (Rico Credit, a microfinance organization), scapp (Scapp, a microfinance organization), tbc (TBC Bank), terabank (Terabank). The list gives the kind of each one that is not a bank. The rates are of today. The tool has no history.

banks.description: Bank codes. Empty asks every bank. The description of the tool lists the codes.

currencies.description: 1 to 10 ISO 4217 codes, for example USD and EUR.

name: rates_get_commercial_rates

banks.description: The rates of each bank that answered, sorted by bank code.

as_of.description: The oldest instant at which the server read a rate of this bank, RFC 3339. The bank publishes no instant.

missing.description: The requested codes that the bank does not quote.

rates.description: The commercial rates, sorted by currency.

buy.description: The price in GEL that the bank pays for one unit, as a decimal string.

sell.description: The price in GEL that the bank asks for one unit, as a decimal string.

stale.description: True when the bank did not answer and the server returns rates it read before.

meaning.description: How to read buy and sell.

unavailable.description: The banks that did not answer.

title: Commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks
